title: Stag
wikitext:
[[image:Stag.png|thumb|]]

Stags are [[beast|beasts]] very similar to [[deer]]. They are larger animals, taller than humans, and they have antlers. Most '''stags''' are [[Neutral|neutral]] when approached. Stags are skinnable. They cannot be tamed by [[hunters]] as [[pet|pets]].

=== Examples ===
* Shadowhorn Stag (Level 20-23, [[Ashenvale]])
* Elder Shadowhorn Stag (Level 25-27, [[Ashenvale]])
* Antlered Courser (Level 21-23, [[Stonetalon Mountains]])
* Mosshoof Stag (Level 49-50, [[Azshara]])
